descriptionFull: The common redstart ( Phoenicurus phoenicurus ), or often simply redstart , is a small passerine bird in the redstart genus Phoenicurus . Like its relatives, it was formerly classed as a member of the thrush family, (Turdidae), but is now known to be an Old World flycatcher (family Muscicapidae).
